Home Décor Double Bust (H-36CM)

Make a bold statement in your living space with the Double Bust Sculpture. Standing at an impressive 36 cm, this contemporary art piece features two minimalist busts joined together on a sleek rectangular base. Each head is sculpted with clean, modern lines and adorned with flowing contour patterns reminiscent of topographical maps, creating a captivating interplay of movement and form. Crafted in a refined metallic finish, the sculpture strikes a balance between avant-garde style and understated elegance. Whether placed on a console, coffee table, bookshelf, or office desk, it commands attention as a conversation starter while blending seamlessly with modern, industrial, or eclectic interiors. This Double Bust is more than just décor; it is an artistic representation of connection, duality, and unity, making it ideal for design enthusiasts and art lovers alike.

Features

  • Modern Artistic Design: Two abstract busts fused into one striking sculpture.
  • Generous Size: Height approx. 36 cm—perfect for shelves, consoles, or centerpieces.
  • Distinctive Pattern: White contour-style lines across the busts create a topographic, organic aesthetic.
  • Premium Finish: Sleek metallic tones add sophistication and complement various color palettes.
  • Durable Build: Made from high-quality resin (or resin blend) mounted on a sturdy rectangular base for stability.
  • Versatile Placement: Ideal for living rooms, offices, lobbies, or galleries as a conversation-starting centerpiece.
  • Symbolic Appeal: Represents connection, togetherness, and modern artistic expression.
  • Easy Maintenance: Simply wipe with a soft, dry cloth to maintain its luster.
  • Gift-Ready: Perfect for art lovers, Home Décor, or as a unique corporate gift.
  • MOQ- 40Pc.
